cor.heading: Revenue and cost of revenue
cor.text:
During the year ended December 31, 2025, we generated revenue of $5,682,985, which represents an increase of $408,490 or 7.7% as compared to the prior year. The increase was mainly attributable to a $469,787 increase in our consultancy services related to facilitating client product sales. This growth was partially offset by a $1,965,628 decrease in our live stream performer training consultancy services, which resulted from a change in the settlement method from a fixed rate on client revenue to a per-head basis. The decrease was largely offset by our newly introduced digital commerce empowerment services, which contributed $1,889,496 in revenue.

Cost of revenue for the year ended December 31, 2025 was $667,721, which represented a slight decrease of $19,440 or 2.8% as compared to the prior year. The decrease in cost of revenue is primarily due to the completion of a consultation service with a service provider on March 31, 2025, which has not recurred. The decrease was partially offset by an increase in payroll for direct staff.

Profit margin for the year ended December 31, 2025 was 88.3%, which represents a slight increase of 1.3% as compared to the prior year.

As a result of the above, the gross profit was $5,015,264 for the year ended December 31, 2025, which represented an increase of $427,930 or 9.3% as compared to the prior year.

intro.text: EUBG was incorporated in the State of Nevada on April 21, 1999 under the name LE GOURMET CO, INC. Since EUBG’s inception, the Company had the following name changes: On March 17, 2003, to Estelle Reyna, Inc.; on September 11, 2003 to Karma Media, Inc.; on July 8, 2005 to Pitboss Entertainment, Inc.; on March 3, 2006 to US Energy Holdings, Inc.; on December 20, 2006 to Lonestar Group Holdings Company; on November 9, 2007 to Guardian Angel Group, Inc.; and on May 18, 2011 to REE International, Inc.; and on March 23, 2020, the Company filed a Certificate of Amendment to the Nevada Secretary of State amending Article I of its Articles of Incorporation changing the Company’s name to Entrepreneur Universe Bright Group, with an effective date of April 3, 2020.

lines.why: Prepayments and other operating items: operating.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Accounts payable
lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Deferred revenue
lines.why: Customers' payments ahead of delivery: operating.

lines.name: Other current liabilities
lines.why: Other operating items due within a year: operating.

lines.name: Long-term debt (incl. current portion)
lines.why: Bonds, notes and loans, current maturities included: financial.

lines.name: Operating lease liabilities
lines.why: Rent owed on leases used in the business: operating by default. Move it to financing to treat leases like debt (if the balance sheet has no lease line of its own, they sit inside other liabilities).

lines.name: Deferred tax liabilities
lines.why: Taxes on operating income deferred: operating.

lines.name: Other assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total assets minus the lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total liabilities minus the lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.
